capabilities: Draw custom symbols with a mouse or trackpad
Trace symbols from a pasted picture
Save symbols as named PNG files
Insert symbols inline as image embeds
extras: Desktop only and requires Obsidian 1.13.4 or later. Symbols are ordinary PNG files, so notes keep showing them if the plugin is disabled or uninstalled. Detailed user guide and file-format docs are on GitHub.
problem: No font exists for invented scripts, ciphers, or personal shorthand, so Obsidian cannot type those symbols inline.
summary: Drawing tool for inventing symbols and inserting them inline in notes as named PNG image embeds.
